role: diagnostic rate/evidence primitive only; no accepted chemistry owner
integration_steps: Create a new versioned generic wrapper; preserve the sealed v6 source and native validators.

Replace only the unique-energy JSON map/evidence cap. Invoke one evidence hook per declared source query or physical pair, including zero-flux/unsupported queries. Keep all existing sigma/kinematics/rate/weight/RNG/selection operations unchanged.
Bind actual immutable input/provider/component/arithmetic/data/mechanism/missing-ledger/phase contexts and declare the query-weight measure. Repeated pair queries are not a unique electron census.

Keep the evidence stream private to the candidate/exposure. A failing physical builder discards its evidence too. Freeze the finished evidence receipt/hash before a common preflight; no independent scientific-state publication is introduced.
Retain replayable query operands externally, or qualify exact checkpoint/event replay. Full-stream hashes alone cannot reconstruct missing dynamic history.
Prove complete candidate/rate/RNG equivalence and error rollback on the future fork. Add production-scale cost admission before using full-provider diagnostics inside every step.
unchanged_physics: no new channels or missing-rate zeros
exact1keV subset policy and its known seam
single-channel native completion and other validators
remaining_limits: The old generic-v6 candidates() remains capped until a separately reviewed fork integrates this primitive. The46726-query test evaluates scalar evidence, not a full large candidate population.
Default1M queries/16GiB encoded query bytes per receipt; hard100M queries; <=64 keys; <=256KiB encoded record and32KiB text. All caps refuse without partial publication.

Nonnegative binary64 evidence weights/source values; exact weight sums reuse2098-bit ExactParticleCount. Moment sums are sums of individually binary64-rounded products. Positive product underflow, overflow or nonfinite rounded totals refuse.
The receipt commits all provider JSON, including unsupported reasons/values. It keeps bounded summaries rather than all raw pointwise JSON; replay requires bound operands/provider/generator.
Evidence validates record shape and content commitment, not an external provider or native epoch. Caller digests must be verified by the host.

Only the frozen v6 provider/layout and recorded floating environment are qualified here. No full chemistry, EEDF, field, trajectory, native mutation, restart-owner or host/GPU deployment qualification.

Full-provider evaluation included in measured8.81CPU-s pass is not production-throughput qualification; typed hooks should reuse already computed query results where possible without changing any value.
